metadata.title: Lenio — Document and process management for educational institutions
metadata.description: The platform where your school centralizes its documentation, administrative processes and approval flows, aligned with ISO 9001 standards.
metadata.ogDescription: Documentation, processes and approvals in one place. Simple, centralized and ISO 9001 aligned.

hero.subtitle: Plan classes, assess your students, automate tasks, and make the most of artificial intelligence to spend more time teaching.

features.title: Everything your institution needs, without the chaos
features.subtitle: The tools already living in your school's daily routine, unified in one simple platform.
features.repoDescription: Centralized institutional file and document management with version control.
features.classesDescription: Board, files, students, assignments and attendance for the academic day-to-day.
features.builderDescription: Build custom institutional forms — minutes, evaluations, whatever your school needs — with a drag-and-drop builder.

funcionalidades.introSubtitle: A platform designed around the real work of teachers: plan, teach, assess and follow up from a single place.
funcionalidades.introProductAlt: Lenio dashboard with the teacher's academic management

alts.assessment: Fragment of the Lenio assessment panel
alts.documents: Organized documents and evidence on a desk

planning.title: Plan with clarity and purpose
planning.description: Structure your classes by connecting standards, resources and evidence. With AI support, draft complete teaching sequences in minutes.

classes.title: Your class, organized from day one
classes.description: Run the daily life of each class in one place: information, resources, students, assignments and attendance without juggling tools.

activities.title: From brief to submission in three steps
activities.description: Create activities, configure the submission and publish them to your whole class. Everything you assign stays connected to the grades.

steps.title: Create
steps.description: Design the activity, the prompts and the assessment criteria.

steps.title: Configure
steps.description: Set the submission format, deadlines and instructions.

steps.title: Publish
steps.description: Share it with your class instantly and track submissions.

assessment.title: Assess learning, not paperwork
assessment.description: Build assessments and rubrics in minutes, collect responses and let the platform organize the results for you.

grading.title: Fewer spreadsheets, more time in class
grading.description: Classify your students' work with clear criteria and generate grades, averages and reports without manual recalculations.

stat.label: less administrative work per week for an average teacher.

documents.title: Your career, in one place
documents.description: Store plans, evidence, resources and forms with version control. Find what you need in seconds and share it with your team.

ai.title: AI in the real work of teachers
ai.description: Not a standalone chatbot: AI lives inside Lenio to help you plan, create, give feedback and analyze without leaving your workspace.

agents.title: Your team of assistants
agents.description: Specialized agents that know your context: they work on your classroom's real problems and follow up with you.

why.title: Built for the schools that lack a robust system today
why.subtitle: Many institutions, especially public and small schools, run their processes with scattered tools. Lenio brings them together with simplicity first.
why.point1Description: A clean interface any teacher adopts without lengthy training.
why.point2Description: Your documentation and processes organized with the quality approach certified by international standards.
why.point3Description: One teacher starts, it grows to the whole school with institutional contracting.

cta.title: Ready to bring order to your institution
cta.subtitle: Create your free account and discover how simple managing your school can be.

precios.title: A plan for every stage of how you work
precios.subtitle: Start free from day one and upgrade whenever you need. Choose the right plan for you or your school.
precios.schoolPlus: School and Pro are complementary: a teacher can have institutional access through their school (School) and, in parallel, their advanced personal tools and AI (Pro).

lite.name: Lite
lite.description: Lenio's entry plan. Start without paying.

go.name: Go
go.description: The budget-friendly plan for individual teachers.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: Lenio's premium individual plan. This is where the difference begins.
